plays.description: Takes the handoff for 11 yards to the 45 and a first down; Mark Andrews motions before the snap.
Gets the edge on second-and-four and is upended near midfield. Ja'Kobi Lane is credited with a key block.
Catches Huntley's pass and holds on through Schwesinger's attempt to strip it for a first down.
Makes a fingertip catch on third-and-six for a first down. Schwesinger attempts to punch the ball out; Ward makes the tackle.
Dodges the rush and scrambles to approximately the 1-yard line after Flowers motions.
Is upended on third-and-goal, bringing up fourth-and-goal.
Following a shift, Huntley uses a play fake and throws to an open Cuevas for a fourth-down touchdown.
Attempts to escape the pocket. The call cuts off; the subsequent discussion of Calais Campbell suggests a sack, but the result is not stated completely.
Makes a sideline reception and runs downfield. Commentary estimates 30 yards to the 31; the DB records 29 yards to the CLE 32 plus roughing the passer on Maliek Collins.
Makes a 34-yard field goal for a 10-0 lead.
Watson has time and completes a pass to Jeudy for a first down on second-and-nine.
Faces pressure up the middle on third down and tries to get rid of the ball. Commentary says Fannin was in the area and grounding should not apply.
Bursts up the middle for 10 yards to the 36.
Against four-man pressure, Huntley checks down to Hill out of the backfield. Tyson Campbell forces him out well short of the first down.
A 59-yard punt is saved back into play by Jackson and leaves Cleveland inside its own 5.
Takes a handoff from near his own 4 and gains a stated six yards for breathing room. The caption's 'first and goal' is inconsistent with this field position.
Tries to get to the edge on third-and-nine and gains four yards before Kyle Hamilton tackles him short at the 21.
plays.concept: quarterback run toward edge; design unknown

plays.description: Huntley takes a hit on a pass completed to Flowers, who is tackled at the 24. The tackler's name cuts off after 'Carson.'
plays.defender_beaten: Carson (surname not stated in this call)

plays.description: Jeudy makes a sliding catch for 14 yards to the Baltimore 47 on second-and-four.
Against a four-man rush on third-and-eight, Watson's pass to Fannin is tipped incomplete by Malaki Starks.
Punt bounces near the 5 and is downed inside Baltimore's 2.
Loses one yard to the 2 on second-and-nine. Maliek Collins gets help from Daniel Thomas.
From his own end zone on third-and-ten, Huntley completes to Lane, who rolls forward for a first down at the 12.
Takes a pass to the 29 for 17 yards and a third-down conversion, with Schwesinger pursuing.
Is sacked back at the 20 by Maliek Collins, with pressure described as coming through the middle.
Escapes backside pressure on third-and-17, is chased by Barnett, and runs across the 30 short of the first down.
Cannot escape incoming pressure and is sacked. The following commentary calls it Cleveland's third sack allowed.
Against four-man pressure, Watson throws too high for Concepcion.
Andrews makes a low catch on third down for a first down, followed by a timeout.
Deep pass down the middle intended for Walker is broken up over his shoulder by Myles Harden.
Huntley rolls and floats a third-and-long pass toward Flowers; Myles Harden deflects it.
Facing pressure on third-and-ten, Watson rolls and completes to Fannin, who lunges close to the first-down marker with Tavius Robinson involved.
Carries and fights forward for a Cleveland first down. The precise down and distance are cut off.
Watson has time on first-and-15 and completes over the middle to Concepcion for a first down.
Concepcion catches a pass over the middle on third-and-13 and reaches the 30, five yards short.
Makes a 48-yard field goal to put Cleveland on the board.
Makes a catch for a first down.
Throws wide of an unnamed target over the middle from a clean pocket on third-and-ten.
Is sacked at the 15 on third-and-four despite Baltimore rushing only three. The sack credit cuts off.
Against four-man pressure, Huntley moves right and throws across his body to Flowers, who spins after the catch for a 31-yard gain.
plays.concept: deep left pass; throw on the move

plays.description: Under pressure on third-and-22, Huntley throws over the middle and Cuevas makes a diving catch.
Misses a 49-yard field goal wide left after a slightly high snap. The caption's proposed '14-3' score is erroneous.
Third-and-four sideline pass to the player called Boston is initially called caught, then corrected to a drop.
Gains five yards off left tackle and fumbles. Carson Schwesinger forces it; Tyson Campbell recovers for Cleveland at the BAL 35.
Concepcion goes up for a pass over the middle on third-and-four and gains 15 yards to the Baltimore 14.
Third-and-seven pass over the middle to Concepcion is batted away by the defender captioned as Keyon Martin. The subsequent discussion suggests a disputed contact call, but the ruling is omitted.
plays.concept: middle pass; commentary references an intended rub involving Fannin

plays.description: With Fannin in motion, runs through right guard for a 2-yard touchdown that ties the game after the extra point.
Third-and-three pass over the middle to Andrews is broken up by Denzel Ward, completing a three-and-out.
Watson flips a short pass and the receiver advances up the sideline. Receiver and gain are omitted.
Against pressure up the middle, Watson finds Jeudy over the middle for a first down; Starks tackles him.
In trouble on third-and-nine, Watson attempts a dump-off to Burton. The result is not explicitly stated.
Misses a 48-yard field goal wide left with the score tied.
Pass against a four-man rush is nearly intercepted. The defender's name is not supplied.
Leaves the pocket under pressure and breaks away on a key third down; the call cuts off before the result.
McLaughlin gains a stated nine yards on first down, with a flag down. The exchange type and penalty ruling are omitted.
Evades backside pressure while looking downfield and makes a move on Calais Campbell. Final action and gain are omitted.
On third-and-five with 42 seconds remaining, Watson finds Jeudy open over the middle for 33 yards to the Baltimore 29; Starks makes the DB-recorded tackle.
Moves left on third-and-five with 11 seconds left to position the ball for Szmyt. Gain and exact finish are not stated.
Kick is called blocked by the defender captioned as Keyon Martin, but a flag follows. Commentary identifies an early start and neutral-zone entry; Cleveland receives a first down.
plays.defender_beaten: Keyon Martin (caption spelling; block and neutral-zone violation)

plays.description: Makes the winning 37-yard field goal as time expires, giving Cleveland a 13-10 win.

offense_strengths: Henry produced an opening 11-yard gain, an edge run near midfield, and a later 10-yard burst up the middle.
Lane repeatedly converted receptions into first downs, including third-and-six and a third-and-ten completion from Baltimore's end zone.
Huntley's movement created a near-goal-line scramble, the play-action touchdown to Cuevas, and the 31-yard completion to Flowers.
Cuevas supplied the 2-yard touchdown and a 29-yard reception.
defense_weaknesses: Cleveland converted multiple middle-field passes to Concepcion, including a 15-yard third-and-four gain after Henry's fumble.
Jeudy repeatedly gained first downs, culminating in the 33-yard third-and-five completion that set up the winning kick.
Baltimore allowed Estime's tying 2-yard right-guard touchdown.
The late neutral-zone violation erased a blocked field-goal attempt and gave Cleveland another opportunity.

offense_strengths: Jeudy supplied repeated first-down receptions, including a 14-yard sliding catch and the decisive 33-yard gain.
Concepcion contributed middle-field completions, including a first down on first-and-15 and a 15-yard third-down conversion.
Burton converted a short-yardage carry, and Estime finished the tying drive with a 2-yard touchdown.
defense_weaknesses: Baltimore found early rushing gains through Henry and a substantial Huntley scramble near the goal line.
Lane repeatedly moved the chains, including on third downs.
Cuevas was open for the fourth-down play-action touchdown and later gained 29 yards on a short right pass.
Huntley escaped pressure to produce Flowers' 31-yard reception.

limitations: Analysis uses only the supplied captions and DB excerpt; no video frames or commands were used. The DB excerpt is selective, so NO DB MATCH does not mean a play did not occur. No personnel grouping, formation, or coverage scheme is explicitly stated in the commentary; all are unknown, including plays whose DB text says shotgun. Rush counts do not establish coverage. Defender_beaten records named tacklers, pursuers, or pass defenders where available and does not necessarily mean they lost coverage. Some names remain caption spellings because no matching DB play permits correction. Null yards indicate an unstated or uncertain gain; the 10-yard Lane catch and 8-yard Concepcion catch are inferred from stated field position or distance remaining. Henry's fumble entry uses the underlying 5-yard rushing gain rather than the DB turnover summary's 0-yard recovery value. Kick distances are attempt lengths. The adjacent Lane catches at 01:06 and 01:12 are listed separately because the captions introduce a new third-and-six, although an edited replay cannot be ruled out. Several calls cut off before their outcomes, and penalty enforcement is sometimes omitted. The initial blocked kick was nullified and is separate from the winning field goal. Kickoffs and returns present only in the DB are excluded because the captions do not identify them.
